description:
# 🐛 Bug-fix PR

## 📌 Summary
Fixes three related bugs in the edit-server modal's selection management in `admin.js`:
- **#3257**: Select All + search drops off-screen selections
- **#3259**: Cancel button crashes and fails to close modal
- **#3260**: Keyword search wipes previously made selections

## 🔁 Reproduction Steps
- #3257: Edit server → Select All → search → clear search → off-screen selections lost
- #3259: Edit server → Cancel → modal fails to close, console error
- #3260: Edit server → check a tool → keyword search → clear → selection gone

## 🐞 Root Cause
- **#3257**: Select All stored IDs only in hidden DOM inputs (`allToolIds`), not in the in-memory `editServerSelections` store. The hidden input gets destroyed by `container.innerHTML = ...` during search.
- **#3259**: `closeModal` had all cleanup in one try block, so any error in type-specific cleanup (e.g. `resetEditSelections`) aborted `modal.classList.add("hidden")` and `AppState.setModalInactive`.
- **#3260**: The flush code before search used `sel.delete(value)` for unchecked checkboxes, which removed selections for tools that appeared in search results but weren't auto-checked (due to UUID/name mismatch). Direct user unchecks are already handled by `ensureEditStoreListeners()`.

## 💡 Fix Description
- **#3257**: After storing IDs in `allIdsInput`, also populate `getEditSelections(selectId)` so selections survive innerHTML replacement.
- **#3259**: Wrapped type-specific cleanup in its own inner `try/catch` so modal always hides even if cleanup throws.
- **#3260**: Changed flush from add/delete to add-only in all three search functions (`serverSideEditToolSearch`, `serverSideEditPromptsSearch`, `serverSideEditResourcesSearch`). Safe because `ensureEditStoreListeners()` already handles real user unchecks via event delegation.

## 🧪 Verification

| Check                                 | Command              | Status |
|---------------------------------------|----------------------|--------|
| Unit tests                            | `uv run pytest`      | ✅      |
| Manual: Select All + search + clear   | browser              | 🔲      |
| Manual: Cancel closes modal cleanly   | browser              | 🔲      |
| Manual: Search preserves selections   | browser              | 🔲      |

## 📐 MCP Compliance (if relevant)
- N/A — UI-only changes, no MCP protocol impact

## ✅ Checklist
- [x] Code formatted
- [x] No secrets/credentials committed
- [x] Single file change (`mcpgateway/static/admin.js`)

reviews.body: Approved. All three original fixes are correct. Added differential unit tests (Vitest), E2E regression tests (Playwright), and fixed an additional gap where resources/prompts Select All was missing the same in-memory store hydration that tools received.

commits.message:
[FIX][UI]: Fix edit-server modal selection bugs (#3257, #3259, #3260)

- Select All now populates in-memory store so selections survive innerHTML replacement during search
- closeModal wraps type-specific cleanup in inner try/catch so modal always hides
- Search flush changed to add-only to prevent unchecked search results from wiping stored selections

Signed-off-by: Madhav Kandukuri <madhav165@gmail.com>

commits.message:
[FIX][UI]: Hydrate in-memory store on Select All for resources and prompts (#3257)

The original #3257 fix only hydrated editServerSelections for tools.
Resources and prompts Select All still only wrote hidden DOM fields
(allResourceIds/allPromptIds) which get destroyed by innerHTML
replacement during search. Apply the same fix to initResourceSelect
and initPromptSelect so off-screen Select All IDs survive search.

Also replace brittle fixed-sleep in Vitest with a polling loop.

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti

commits.message:
[TESTING][UI]: Add E2E coverage for resource/prompt Select All persistence (#3257)

Replace the no-op test_resource_and_prompt_search_preserves_selections
(which created servers without resources/prompts and silently skipped
all assertions) with two targeted tests that:
- Click Select All resources/prompts in the edit modal
- Verify the in-memory store is populated
- Search + clear
- Assert store size is unchanged

Also add edit_select_all_resources_btn, edit_select_all_prompts_btn
locators and store-size helpers to ServersPage.

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
